page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a running head at the top and a page number at the top left. Below the text, after a blank space, a line "CAP." set at the right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: ste Euseb. Lib. 6. Hist. Eccles. Cap. 3. Postea autem in Palæstinam se contulit Origenes, & Cæsareæ ludum aperuit, ubi licet nondum Presbyterij gradu potitus esset, ab Episcopis, qui ibi erant, ad disputandum, & ad sacras etiam Scripturas in communi Ecclesiæ conventu aperiendas admissus est. Posterior hæc libertas concionandi coram populo displicuit Demetrio, Episcopo Alexandrino, sed factum suum in concedenda illa libertate Alexander Hierosolymorum Episcopus, & Theoctistus Cæsareæ Episcopus defenderunt exemplis aliorum quorundam Episcoporum, qui Laicos quosdam, habiles & idoneos ad præbendum fratribus adjumentum, hortati fuerant ut populum in verbo instituerent, τῷ λαῷ συνομιλεῖν [?]: ut scribit Eusebius Lib. 6. Hist. Cap. 13. x. Quamvis hac quidem in parte fortasse non male senserit DEMETRIUS.

page.notes: The Greek phrase at the line end is only partly legible and is marked [?]. The printed "Euseb" and similar forms keep the printer's long-s spelling as plain s where relevant. "DEMETRIUS" has its final letters in a stylised form; the reading is likely. The "CAP." at the foot is shown as printed, with no number following.
